entries.question: Appointment
entries.answer:
To book an OPD appointment at KGMU (King George's Medical University), please note that online registration is mandatory. Here are the available booking methods:

1. **Online via ORS:** Visit the [Online Registration System (ORS)](https://ors.gov.in), select Uttar Pradesh, choose KGMU, pick your department and date, enter patient details, pay the ₹50 fee, and download your slip.
2. **ABHA / Health Care App:** Register using your mobile number and OTP, then follow the same state and hospital selection flow.
3. **By SMS:** Send an SMS in the format `APPOINTMENT <Patient Name>` to **8887019134**.
4. **Walk-in:** Bring your Aadhaar number and active mobile number to the hospital counter to generate an OTP, collect a physical token, pay the ₹50 OPD slip fee, and collect your slip.

**Important Notes:**
- OPD timings: Monday to Friday (9:00 AM – 1:00 PM), Saturday (9:00 AM – 12:00 PM); closed on Sundays.
- The ticket counter/parchi window closes sharp at 1:00 PM.
- Patients from outside Lucknow must carry a valid referral slip for the specific department. Pre-booking is strongly recommended. 

*(For safety, please avoid sharing personal health records, Aadhaar numbers, or phone numbers in this chat.)*

entries.question: कृपया उचित मार्गदर्शन दे
entries.answer:
KGMU के दंत संकाय (Faculty of Dental Sciences) में BDS (Bachelor of Dental Surgery) कोर्स में प्रवेश के लिए आपको राष्ट्रीय स्तर पर आयोजित होने वाली **NEET-UG (National Eligibility cum Entrance Test - Undergraduate)** परीक्षा उत्तीर्ण करनी होगी।

### योग्यता (Eligibility Criteria):
1. **शैक्षणिक योग्यता:** चूँकि आपने B.Sc. (Biology) से किया है, आपने 10+2 (Physics, Chemistry, Biology/Biotechnology) अवश्य पढ़ा होगा। BDS पाठ्यक्रम में प्रवेश के लिए 10+2 या समकक्ष परीक्षा में भौतिकी, रसायन विज्ञान, जीव विज्ञान/जैव प्रौद्योगिकी और अंग्रेजी में न्यूनतम आवश्यक अंक (सामान्य वर्ग के लिए आमतौर पर 50%) होने चाहिए।
2. **आयु सीमा:** प्रवेश के वर्ष के 31 दिसंबर तक न्यूनतम आयु 17 वर्ष होनी चाहिए।
3. **प्रवेश परीक्षा:** NEET-UG परीक्षा में शामिल होना और NTA द्वारा निर्धारित कट-ऑफ अंक प्राप्त करना अनिवार्य है।

### प्रवेश प्रक्रिया (Admission Process):
1. **NEET-UG परीक्षा दें:** आपको हर साल आयोजित होने वाली NEET-UG परीक्षा के लिए आवेदन करना और उसमें शामिल होना होगा।
2. **काउंसलिंग (Counselling):** NEET परिणाम के बाद, उत्तर प्रदेश की राज्य नीट काउंसलिंग (UP NEET Counselling) या अखिल भारतीय कोटा (AIQ) काउंसलिंग के माध्यम से KGMU में BDS सीट के लिए आवेदन करना होगा। चयन पूरी तरह से NEET मेरिट रैंक के आधार पर होता है।

आप प्रवेश से जुड़ी अधिक जानकारी और अपडेट के लिए आधिकारिक [KGMU Admissions पेज](https://www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php) देख सकते हैं।

entries.question: किस महीने में फार्म निकलता है
entries.answer:

1. **Online (ORS Portal):** [ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) par jayein, State mein Uttar Pradesh chun kar KGMU select karein. Department aur available date chun kar patient ki details bharein aur ₹50 ka OPD slip fee pay karein. Slip download kar lein.
2. **Mobile App:** ABHA ya Health Care App ke zariye mobile number aur OTP se register karke same hospital selection flow follow karein.
3. **SMS Booking:** `APPOINTMENT <Patient Name>` likh kar 8887019134 par SMS bhejein.
4. **Walk-in (Hospital Counter):** KGMU aakar apna Aadhaar number aur active mobile number dein. OTP verify hone aur ₹50 fee pay karne ke baad OPD slip mil jayegi.

### Timing & Fees:
- **OPD Timings:** Monday se Friday (9:00 AM – 1:00 PM) aur Saturday (9:00 AM – 12:00 PM). Sunday ko OPD band rehti hai.
- **Parchi Counter:** Parchi/ticket counter dopahar 1:00 PM tak hi khula rehta hai.
- **OPD Slip Fee:** Sabhi booking methods ke liye ₹50 hai.
- **Referral:** Agar aap Lucknow ke bahar se hain, toh apne ilaake ke doctor ka valid referral saath zaroor layein. 

*Note: Bheed se bachne ke liye pre-booking karna behtar rehta hai.*

entries.question: Meri marksheet kho gai hai to kaise duplicate banwaye
entries.answer:
To obtain a duplicate marksheet at King George's Medical University (KGMU), you generally need to follow these steps:

1. **File an FIR / Police Report:** Report the loss of your original marksheet at your nearest police station and keep a copy of the FIR or police complaint acknowledgment.
2. **Affidavit:** Prepare an affidavit on non-judicial stamp paper stating the loss of your marksheet and details of the examination passed.
3. **Application to the Controller of Examinations:** Submit a formal written application addressed to the **Controller of Examinations, KGMU**, attaching your ID proof, copy of the FIR, affidavit, and fee receipt.
4. **Fees:** Pay the required duplicate certificate/marksheet fee at the university counter or designated bank.

For specific application formats, prescribed fees, and official guidelines, please visit the [KGMU Guidelines Page](https://kgmu.org/guidelines.php) or contact the Examination Department through the [KGMU Notice Board](https://kgmu.org/kgmu_notice_board.php).

entries.question: How to book slot online
entries.answer:
To book an online OPD slot at King George's Medical University (KGMU), you can use the Online Registration System (ORS) or the ABHA / Health Care App. 

Here are the step-by-step booking methods:

### 1. Booking via ORS (Online Registration System)
1. Visit the official portal at [ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in).
2. Register or log in using your mobile number.
3. Select your state (**Uttar Pradesh**) and choose **KGMU** from the hospital list.
4. Select **New Appointment**, choose the required department, date, and time slot.
5. Enter the patient details.
6. Pay the online OPD registration fee of **₹50**.
7. Download or print the appointment slip.

### 2. Booking via ABHA / Health Care App
1. Register on the app using your mobile number and the OTP received.
2. Select the state and hospital (**KGMU**).
3. Follow the same flow (Department, Date, Time Slot, and Patient Details).
4. Pay the ₹50 fee and download the slip.

### Alternative Booking Methods:
- **SMS:** Send `Appointment [Patient Name]` to **8887019134**.
- **Walk-in:** Visit the KGMU counter with your Aadhaar number and active mobile number to collect a physical token, pay ₹50, and get your OPD slip.

*Note:* Online registration is mandatory, and pre-booking is strongly recommended to avoid wait times. The ticket counter closes at 1:00 PM sharp. Outside-city patients must bring a valid referral for their specific department.

entries.question: How to book appointment
entries.answer:
To book an OPD appointment at King George's Medical University (KGMU), online registration is mandatory. You can use any of the following methods:

1. **Online Registration System (ORS):**
   - Visit [ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in).
   - Log in or register using your mobile number.
   - Select **Uttar Pradesh** as the state and **KGMU** as the hospital.
   - Choose **New Appointment**, select your preferred department and date, enter patient details, pay the ₹50 OPD slip fee, and download the slip.

2. **ABHA / Health Care App:**
   - Register using your mobile number and OTP, then follow the same state and hospital selection workflow as ORS.

3. **SMS Booking:**
   - Send an SMS in the format `APPOINTMENT <NAME>` to **8887019134**.

4. **Walk-In Booking:**
   - Visit the hospital in person with your Aadhaar number and active mobile number. Generate an OTP at the counter, get a physical token, pay the ₹50 fee, and collect your OPD slip.

**Important Notes:**
- **OPD Timings:** Monday–Friday 9:00 AM–1:00 PM; Saturday 9:00 AM–12:00 PM; closed on Sundays.
- **Fees:** The OPD slip fee is ₹50 across all booking methods.
- **Referral:** Outside-city patients must bring a valid referral for their specific department.
- **Cut-off Time:** The ticket/parchi counter closes sharply at 1:00 PM. Pre-booking is strongly recommended to avoid long wait times.
